shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; git branch -a; ls; cat next.config.*; find app src -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

for f in app/*.tsx app/*/*.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; git diff package.json; git log --oneline | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -20

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n "hours" 03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | head; awk '/^## Following validation/,/^## `dynamic = "force-dynamic"`/' 02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -80
